summary: This note surveys the local music scene across genres after September 1, 2023, covering classical, chamber, opera, jazz, folk and indie, crossover and youth programs. It highlights specific ensembles, venues, events and dates, and stresses how traditional genres are becoming more accessible and innovative while nurturing young talent.
one_line: A genre-by-genre tour of the local music scene, from symphony and opera to jazz, indie, crossover acts and youth programs.
key_facts: The Metropolitan Symphony, the city's premiere orchestra, is led by Maestra Vivian Ramirez, appointed October 2023.
The Metropolitan Symphony performed "Autumn Overture" on November 5.
Vivian Ramirez inaugurated the Symphony's youth program in December 2023, letting young instrumentalists compose and showcase their own works.
The Oakwood String Quartet performed Ravel's String Quartet in F major at Echo Hall on January 22.
The Riverwind Piano Trio's "Living Room Concerts" take place in venues such as art galleries and historical homes.
The Urban Opera Collective staged a modern version of Mozart's "The Magic Flute" on February 15 with multimedia projections.
Opera al Fresco, launched in the past spring, presents opera in open-air venues such as parks and community centers.
The Blue Note Corner, a historic venue since the 1950s, hosts the weekly "Jazz Evolution Series".
Trombonist Marcus Little had a sold-out 75th birthday bash on September 19 and has since mentored young artists.
The City Jazz Festival celebrated its fifth edition on October 28 and includes international acts.
The "Strings and Stories" folk festival took place on March 15, featuring songwriters like Emma Clarke.
Indie band "Patchwork Harmony" launched an album on April 10th, supported by venues like The Artisan's Cellar.
The GlobalFusion Project, founded by Reina Torres and Jake Kim, held a January 28th concert mixing classical Indian ragas with Afro-Cuban rhythms.
The School of Music and Arts, directed by Julianne Beck, saw enrollment rise after introducing its "Future Maestros" program in late 2023; its "Youthful Harmonies" concert was on February 26.
